name: db3-dexhand
description: Legacy .db3 dexterous-hand rig, lenient alignment for heavy frame loss
_comment: FREQUENTLY TUNED: the video block below; an explicit CLI flag always wins.
Same leniency as db3-gripper, against the 20-DoF hand profile. See that
recipe's notes for what each relaxation costs -- they apply identically here.
For head-only recordings in this generation pass --profile marvin-dexhand-head;
the camera count is part of the feature set, so those are a separate dataset.
notes: A dexhand batch is state_dim 54 against the gripper's 16, so it can never share
a LeRobot dataset with a gripper batch however similar the task.
The hands publish JointState with measured feedback, so their observation is a
real measurement rather than a command echo -- unlike the tj-dexhand generation.
Both hand command topics are fillable: if one hand is silent for a whole
recording, missing_topic_policy fill copies its measured joints into the action.
Confirm the hand was genuinely parked before training on those episodes.
